When the waves are up, politicians who say power is just surfing on it.
With the power of the revolution, those politicians who've been in power don't need to show any trace of achievement or development.
They just have to keep making noise like humanitarian defenders until they're considered heroes.

The political pattern of the revolution is now beginning to develop. The Sambo case and Kanjuruhan tragedy became an issue used to encourage the rise of revolution.

The Sambo case and Kanjurhan tragedy were photographed as the great failure of the Jokowi era government. Interestingly this time, pressure also comes from international. The pressure from the international will certainly drive a bigger wave.
This wave is certainly getting more and more beloved by politicians. Entering politics 2024, society as key holders needs to learn and do reflection. We can't just be a few people's powers of power.

The process of changes that begin to take place from every era, the government must continue to care for and maintain them. We can't keep getting stuck in a system of reform and revolution that's loaded with lots of stowaways.
